description: Source file implementing filename utility functions for safe path validation and filename generation within the net namespace, including functions for checking path components, relative paths, and generating filenames based on URLs and content disposition.

methods.name: IsSafePortablePathComponent
methods.description: Checks if a given file path component is safe and valid for portable use.

methods.name: IsSafePortableRelativePath
methods.description: Validates if a relative path is safe and portable.

methods.name: GetSuggestedFilename
methods.description: Generates a suggested filename based on URL and content disposition.

methods.name: GenerateFileName
methods.description: Generates a filename for a download based on URL, content disposition, and other parameters.
